hadith:
Interpretation of Dreams - Narated Ubaidullah bin Abdullah:

I asked Ibn Abbas about the dream of Allah's Messenger which he mentioned. (see following hadith)
message: Allah gives good news to the believers of a great bounty. When you are in need, turn to Allah, As-Samad—the One all creation depends on, while He needs nothing.
name:
As Samad - الصَّمَدُ - The Eternal Refuge

As Samad is the One to whom all creation turns in need, while He Himself needs nothing. In explanations of Quran 112:2, this includes complete self-sufficiency and perfect lordship. The Eternal Refuge is a short label for this meaning, not merely a claim about enduring forever.
verse:
Al-Ahzab - The Combined Forces - 33:47

Give good news to the believers that they will have a great bounty from Allah.
